statement: Koko has n piles of bananas; piles[i] is the number of bananas in pile i. She has h hours before the guards come back.

She picks an eating speed k, in bananas per hour. Each hour she chooses one pile and eats k bananas from it. If the pile has fewer than k left, she finishes it and does nothing else that hour. Pile i therefore takes ⌈piles[i] / k⌉ hours.
Return the smallest integer k that lets her finish every pile within h hours. The answer lies between 1 and max(piles), and a faster speed never takes longer, so binary search on k.

examples.explanation: At 4 per hour the piles take 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 8 hours, which fits. At 3 per hour they take 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10 hours, which is too many.
With 5 piles and 5 hours she has exactly one hour per pile, so k must cover the largest pile in one go: 30.
